import os,subprocess,time,re,json,hashlib,statistics
r=Path(os.environ['TEMP'])/'llmx-live-generation'
model=Path.home()/'.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF/snapshots/23749fefcc72300e3a2ad315e1317431b06b590a/Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf'
executables={'before':r.parent/'llmx build version final/project build/llmx.exe','candidate':r/'build/llmx.exe'}
rows=[];reference=None
for round_id in range(4):
 for arm in (['before','candidate'] if round_id%2==0 else ['candidate','before']):
  args=[str(executables[arm]),'generate',str(model),'Write a detailed explanation of how rain forms.','--threads','6','--temp','0','--think','-n','64']
  start=time.perf_counter();p=subprocess.Popen(args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,bufsize=0)
  header=bytearray()
  while not header.endswith(b'\n'):
   b=p.stdout.read(1)
   assert b,'no prefill header'
   header.extend(b)
  first=p.stdout.read(1);visible=time.perf_counter()-start
  rest=p.stdout.read();stderr=p.stderr.read();p.wait();elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
  assert p.returncode==0 and not stderr,(p.returncode,stderr)
  data=(bytes(header)+first+rest).replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
  match=re.search(rb'\ntg: (\d+) tok, ([0-9.]+) ms, ([0-9.]+) tok/s\n$',data)
  assert match and int(match[1])==64,data[-200:]
  body=data[data.index(b'\n')+1:match.start()]
  if reference is None:reference=body
  assert body==reference,'streaming changed output bytes'
  (r/('latency-'+str(round_id)+'-'+arm+'.stdout')).write_bytes(data)
  rows.append(dict(round=round_id,warmup=round_id==0,arm=arm,command=args,first_text_seconds=visible,total_seconds=elapsed,tg_tps=float(match[3]),text_sha256=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()))
  (r/'latency.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2));print(round_id,arm,round(visible,3),round(elapsed,3),flush=True)
summary={arm:{key:statistics.median(x[key] for x in rows if x['arm']==arm and not x['warmup']) for key in ['first_text_seconds','total_seconds','tg_tps']} for arm in executables}
(r/'latency-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2));print(summary)
